name: Click Assist (Practice)
description: Practice aid: if an early click would kill you, retries it up to N ticks later. Shows a label and puts the attempt in test mode, so progress and completions are not saved.

enabled.name: Enable Click Assist
enabled.description: Turns the assist on. While on, the attempt runs in test mode and nothing is saved.

window.name: Assist window (ticks)
window.description: How many ticks too early a click can be and still get corrected. GD runs at 240 ticks per second, so 4 ticks is about 17 ms.

lookahead.name: Death lookahead (ticks)
lookahead.description: How long after a click a death still counts as caused by that click. 120 ticks is half a second.
